storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard; keep the lid tight to stop it absorbing moisture.
looksLike: A light-brown to tan, tangy-salty ground blend with a cumin, fennel and dry-mango smell, sold in 50 g to 100 g jars and pouches; Mumbai-style sandwiches get a sprinkle of it over the filling.
howToPick: Check the ingredient list (cumin, fennel, pepper, amchur, black salt are common) and buy a sealed jar with a tangy, fresh smell; avoid damp or clumped packs.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months in the sealed pack (general guidance; check the best-before). (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run)
substitutes: Chat masala plus a pinch of black pepper

usedIn.raw: 1 g per serving (½ tsp; the dish lists 'sandwich masala or chaat masala')
